title: Services
subtitle: Four areas of practice, one philosophy: think before touching.
fraseGuia: Before any treatment, we evaluate your case, explain the options, and give you a written plan in stages.
intro: We don't sell procedures. We diagnose first and show you all the options, with price and timeline. The Diagnostic & Planning Consultation is the entry point for understanding your case before deciding.

puertaEntrada.descripcion: Listening to your reason for consultation, clinical evaluation, reading records and studies, explanation of findings, options by stages, priorities, and next steps.
puertaEntrada.noPromete: It does not promise a definitive diagnosis without necessary studies, a closed quote by WhatsApp, a perfect aesthetic solution, or immediate treatment without planning.

services.descripcionCorta: Think your case through before acting.
services.descripcion: The flagship service. Before any treatment, we evaluate clinically, read records and studies, explain findings and deliver a written plan with priorities. In stages, with timelines, with costs.
services.paraQuien: Anyone who has to make an important decision about their mouth.
incluye: Listening to your reason for consultation

services.descripcionCorta: A photo isn't enough to diagnose.
services.descripcion: If someone else told you that you need an important treatment, we review your case independently, with no conflict of interest. Written opinion with options and prioritized plan.
services.paraQuien: Patients who received a diagnosis or high quote and want to understand if it's necessary.
noIncluye: Confirming what the other doctor said
Doing the treatment without you deciding

services.descripcion: Restoring function, stability, aesthetics and confidence inside a mouth that has history. Integrates diagnosis, periodontics, endodontics, occlusion and aesthetics when appropriate.
services.paraQuien: Mouths with prior treatments, missing teeth, wear, occlusal pain, or need for wide restoration.
noIncluye: Deciding without listening to the patient

services.descripcion: Veneers, aesthetic restorations and smile design with biological judgment. Aesthetics should not stand above biology. If a tooth is healthy, it doesn't get drilled to follow a trend.
services.paraQuien: Patients who want to improve their smile while respecting the health of their teeth.
incluye: Veneers with prep only when indicated
noIncluye: Veneers on healthy teeth for trend

services.descripcion: Restorations, endodontics, prophylaxis and restorative work with judgment. A small lesion can hide something larger. Before touching, you must interpret.
services.paraQuien: Patients who need clinical care with conservative judgment.
